words.definition: A collection or gathering of things

words.definition: Avoidance of activity or exertion; laziness
words.example: Her indolence kept her from finishing the project on time.

words.definition: Not disturbed or troubled by something
words.example: The cat was unbothered by the vacuum cleaner dance party.

words.definition: Uncertain or slow to act due to doubt or fear
words.example: I was hesitant to try the purple mystery casserole.

words.definition: A place where things are stored or collected
words.example: My brain is a vast repository of silly song lyrics.

words.definition: A formal request, often signed by many people

words.definition: An assumption or hypothesis without proof

words.definition: To break into small pieces or collapse gradually

words.definition: Understanding or feeling someone else’s feelings, especially sadness
words.example: I felt sympathy for the dog who lost his ball.

words.definition: A feeling or belief that something is wrong or likely true without proof

words.definition: something accepted as true without proof

words.definition: Reaching out or extending in the direction of something

words.definition: In an awkward or uncoordinated way

words.definition: An improvement or increase in quality or value

words.definition: Something made or invented; a lie or falsehood

words.definition: A surprising or unknown fact made known

words.definition: Not qualified or allowed to do or be something

words.definition: Something that does not follow a rule or pattern

words.example: We decided to launch the new product with a massive cake.

words.definition: To reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree

words.definition: To represent or stand for something else

words.definition: Able to be trusted or depended on
